gloss: war fire; flames of war; ravages of war

definitions.gloss: war fire; flames of war; ravages of war; wartime destruction
definitions.explanation: The fires and destruction caused by war, or war itself viewed as a destructive force. Used both literally for fires caused by bombing and figuratively for the devastation of armed conflict.

examples.japanese: {戦火|せんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧。
examples.english: To escape the flames of war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戦火|せんか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧になった。
examples.english: The city was reduced to a burnt wasteland by war.

examples.japanese: {戦火|せんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{免|まぬが}れた→免れる：10548_manugareru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{文化財|ぶんかざい}→文化財：12932_bunkazai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: This temple, which escaped the ravages of war, still preserves precious cultural artifacts from hundreds of years ago.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (war, battle) and {火|か} (fire). A literary and somewhat formal word evoking the destructive power of war. Frequently appears in historical writing, news reporting on conflicts, and memorial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦火|せんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to flee from war
- {戦火|せんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{免|まぬが}れる→免れる：10548_manugareru⟧: to be spared from wartime destruction
- {戦火|せんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to be caught up in war
- {戦火|せんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: the flames of war spread
- {戦火|せんか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: lost to war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦禍|せんか}: war damage, ravages of war — homophone with the same meaning, but written with {禍|か} (calamity) instead of {火|か} (fire)
- {砲火|ほうか}: gunfire, bombardment — specifically the firing of weapons
- ⟦{戦乱|せんらん}→戦乱：13277_senran⟧: war and chaos — focuses on the social upheaval caused by war
